message: The other day, our family group chat lit up with ideas on how to prepare for any surprises life might throw our way. It reminded me of the importance of involving the kids in these conversations—after all, they can be little champions of preparedness! 🌟 There’s a great resource I found that makes it fun and engaging for children to learn about safety. It’s a gentle reminder that being ready can bring us all a little closer together. Have you talked to your little ones about this yet?
